findings.evidence: `push_ledger` extracts `.workflow_runs[].head_sha`, while `.github/workflows/pr-build.yml:24-25` uses `pull_request_target`; GitHub documents `GITHUB_SHA` for this event as the last commit on the default/base branch and requires `github.event.pull_request.head.sha` for the PR head.
findings.fix: Obtain and validate the PR number and `pull_request.head.sha` from a source that records the event payload (or explicitly persist them in the workflow); do not use workflow-run `head_sha`.
findings.issue: The ledger treats each `pull_request_target` workflow run's `.head_sha` as the pushed PR head, but that event runs on the last commit of the base/default branch; the resulting keys are main SHAs rather than `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`.

findings.evidence: `Mirror.fetch` fetches only the current PR refs at lines 205-207; `pr_epochs` derives candidates solely from `mirror.pr_heads(number)` and never iterates historical ledger heads.
findings.fix: Associate ledger entries with PR numbers, replay those head SHAs directly, and fetch/preserve every recorded head object needed by `merge-tree`.
findings.issue: Historical force-pushed heads cannot be reconstructed: `pr_heads` only walks commits reachable from the current `refs/pull/N/head`, then line 323 intersects the ledger with that list, discarding every ledger-recorded head removed by a force-push.

findings.evidence: Lines 323-326 return only `pushed` matches whenever the list is nonempty; the fallback at lines 327-332 runs only when there are zero matches.
findings.fix: Require demonstrably complete per-PR ledger coverage or model mixed recorded/inferred epochs explicitly and report that provenance.
findings.issue: Any single matching ledger entry makes the whole PR `pushed`, silently dropping all unmatched epochs; partial retention, API holes, or aged-out runs therefore truncate episodes while being reported as fully recorded.

summary: The purported push ledger does not record PR-head SHAs, and the replay also loses historical and partially covered head transitions. Therefore the reported conflict durations and attribution are not faithful.
